name: fg_branch
why: Fullest bough with the clearest snow layering; reads as a clean shape when darkened.

name: fg_reeds
why: Most readable silhouettes, birch-ply stems give warmth, no purple blades muddying it.

name: fg_rocks
why: Best spacing of the three stones and cleanest laminated snow caps, closest to the current footprint.

name: ground_forest
why: Seam heights match exactly (588/588), calm swells, sparse spruce and birch sprigs.

name: ground_harbour
why: Exact seam (597/597), single snow-capped bollard reads as harbour without clutter.

name: ground_lake
why: Exact seam, clearest ice surface with hairline cracks and gentle swell.

name: ground_sauna
why: Exact seam, best-read woodpile and stumps, bottom fully opaque (v3 was 236).

name: ground_shore
why: Exact seam, balanced grass tufts and stones, cleanest lamination.

name: far_islands
why: Seam within 1 px, lowest and calmest silhouette so it sits behind the hills.

name: far_mountains
why: Only variant with an exact seam (782/782); soft lilac ridges stay far.

name: mid_hills_spruce
why: Exact seam (633/633) and the clearest depth layering; v1 has a floating hill fragment.

name: mid_birch_grove
why: Clean transparent background (v2 baked in fog), ground seam within 8 px, airy rhythm.

name: sky_aurora
why: Three laminated ribbons with the brightest middle band, closest to the Layers of Light concept.

name: sky_dawn_cloud_1
why: Fullest cumulus mass with clear lamination, reads at small size.

name: sky_dawn_cloud_2
why: Two stacked lenticular layers, best proportion and taper.

name: sky_dawn_cloud_3
why: Most even chain of small wisps, distinct from clouds 1 and 2.

name: fog_band
why: Thinnest and most translucent band (v1 and v3 are near-opaque slabs); staged without alpha clamp.

name: fog_band_b
why: Flat, mostly translucent band that contrasts with the wavier fog_band; staged without alpha clamp.
